name: varro-openjet-webview
description: Build workspace for the Varro webview running inside JetBrains JCEF.

comments.versions: Dependency versions are pinned to the upstream Varro revision recorded in upstream.json so the vendored sources build against the libraries they were written for.
comments.toolchain: node/npm are pinned with Volta and matched exactly by the Dockerfile. npm writes package-lock.json differently across versions, so an unpinned toolchain makes the lockfile churn on every build.
